item.title: NASA finds giant 10-sided pattern at Saturn's south pole
item.description: A massive 10-sided atmospheric feature has been spotted around Saturn's south pole, mirroring the planet's well-known northern hexagon.

item.title: Immune cell switch may drive aging throughout the body
item.description: Aging could be linked to immune cells failing to clear damaged, inflammation-causing cells. Blocking a single receptor may restore this function.
